name: archive

steps.action: C54 step 12-15: Archive takes the whole Document out of the ordinary list and Show archived finds it
steps.actual: Archive removed the row from the ordinary list in one action; Show archived brought it back marked Archived with all three Versions, the executed pin on v2 and every stored file still downloadable. Archiving destroys nothing

steps.action: C54 step 19-23: Restore brings the Document and its designations back
steps.actual: Restore returned the Document to the ordinary list with its three Versions and the executed-copy designation exactly as before

steps.action: C54 step 25 negative: restoring is refused while the owning record is archived, and a lost race is reported
steps.actual: While the owning Contract was archived the restore answered 409 and the record offered no Document controls at all; after the record was restored the Document restored normally, and a second restore of the same Document from another session answered 409, which is the stale state the guide tells the reader to reload on

steps.action: C54 step 31-34: the typed confirmation gates deletion, Cancel preserves, and Delete removes the whole Document
steps.actual: Delete stayed disabled until the Document's displayed name was typed exactly; a wrong name kept it disabled and Cancel left all three Versions in place. Typing the real name enabled a button reading Delete, and confirming removed the row and answered 404 for every one of the three Version downloads, with no replacement primary chosen. The row, the downloads and the History entry are browser and API observations; that the stored files themselves are gone is verified by direct inspection of the lab volume in independent-erasure.json

steps.action: C54 step 36: the erasure is recorded and there is no way to delete a single Version
steps.actual: The record's History still named the erased Document after its rows and files were gone, and asking the seam to remove one Version answered 404 while that chain kept both rounds. Deletion is whole-Document only, as the guide states
